checks.detail: TaskSpec envelope payload_sha256 matches the committed T6 spec; allowed_files cover operations.py, the ops CLI test, and all evidence outputs; baseline and eight input evidence references hash-match live files.

BackfillAdapter consumes a deterministic TokenBucketLimiter with injectable clock; exhausted capacity stops the run with THROTTLED and preserves a per-shard cursor so the next run resumes exactly where it stopped.
build_plan partitions total_items into balanced contiguous shards (start/end/item_count), sums to total_items, forces priority='low' on the P7 synthetic surface, and rejects any other priority.

pause() stops between items/shards, the run returns PAUSED with completed shard ids, resume() continues from the stored cursor without reprocessing items and without losing progress; completion is detected per shard by cursor==end.

BackfillAdapter rejects the repository root and protected authority/operational roots with ProtectedStoreError, requires an existing fixture root, exposes status() with real_backfill=False, and never touches real research/data/KBase/campaign content.
The only tracked source changes are operations.py and tests/test_control_plane_ops_cli.py; no sealed TCB, policy, inventory, authority, store, run_research.py, or memory.py file changed.
All seven new tests failed before implementation (AttributeError on the missing surface), then passed 7/7 after implementation; focused ops CLI suite is 18/18.

Authority pre-state is slice-completion ready: authorization CLAIMED, grant ACTIVE, T6 ticket ISSUED with zero trusted receipts, one open ticket, succeeded=(T1..T5), no failed/in-doubt, pending outbox 0, no P7 closure.

advisories.detail: run_research.py is outside T6 allowed_files; exposing the backfill adapter through a CLI command is a non-blocking follow-up for a slice that owns run_research.py.
